statement.p: Suppose that f(x) is a function with f(130) = 46 and f'(130) = 1. Estimate f(126).

static.solution: f(130) = 46 and f'(130) = 1 tell us that at x = 130, the value of the function is 46 and the function is increasing at a rate of 1 units for a unit increase in x. Since we increase x by -4 units in going from 130 to 126, the value of the function goes up by approximately -4 \cdot 1 = -4 units, so f(126) \approx 46 - 4 \cdot 1 = 46 - 4 = 42.
